items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the internal frost-fractured valve. The calibrated gross price is €52 for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that must be renewed with the fractured fitting. One like-for-like hose is estimated at €27 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover labour needed to repair the fitting. The calibrated gross total for three hours is €299.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used on the repair, but this generic line does not distinguish them from excluded tools or overhead under 3.6. If substantiated, a small allowance of €6 gross is reasonable.
Section 7.1.11 covers one attendance by the plumber for the insured event, and no separate return trip is billed. The closest same-wording cases support €40 gross.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to trace the insured escape. The calibrated €17.60 gross equipment charge is below the €2,500 event limit.

items.description: Facade damage from escaped water freezing
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers render saturated by water from the internal escape and then damaged by freezing, without the external-frost option. Allow €155 gross if this line prices distinct local repair work rather than merely describing or duplicating the following lines.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of failed plaster in the water-damaged patch. A modest allowance for one localized removal item is €95 gross, provided it is not already included elsewhere.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the damaged patch. The calibrated gross line total is €38.
Sections 7.1.5 and 9.6 require the work to be identifiable and attributable to the damaged patch. If itemisation shows distinct, necessary minor repair work, a conditional allowance is €30 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers preparing and re-forming the substrate damaged by the water escape. The calibrated gross line total is €31.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(d) cover repainting the affected patch in as many coats as the pre-loss finish system requires. The calibrated gross allowance is €59 for the line.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover necessary drying of the wall saturated by the internal escape before reinstatement. The calibrated gross line total is €254.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers priming needed to restore the damaged patch to its pre-loss finish. The calibrated gross line total is €117.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour restoring the affected patch, not work on undamaged areas. The calibrated gross total for five hours is €277.

Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude administrative add-ons, and the label identifies no covered work. If clarified as a distinct minor repair task rather than a surcharge, the conditional estimate is €25 gross.
